steps.name: Estimate-first rule
steps.whatToDo: Before answering, write an estimate or expected form of the answer (size, sign, units, key term). Compare at the end. Applies to every application item for two weeks.

steps.name: Slow-down protocol on D1–D2 items
steps.whatToDo: Timed practice is paused; reach 95% accuracy on D1 to D2 items before timed work resumes.

steps.name: Sleep / study-block hygiene check
steps.whatToDo: If sleep is short or a phone is in the study block, fix that first via the parent form (M2). Support context only, never a score.

gaps.moneyCheck: Budget available but gap is shallow: free plan first; keep the money for a re-test in 3 weeks.
gaps.retestRule: Re-give the failed items (parallel versions from the wider bank) after the plan, then a 7-day retention probe. Log the attempts → ECV; if the level has not moved by 2 after the planned 0.1 weeks, re-diagnose – the gap type was probably wrong (usually G1 hiding under G3).

plan.orderOfOperations: Optimising time, effort and money – the order of operations: (1) diagnose with the paper + one probe (10 min); (2) fix prerequisites before anything else; (3) use free, high-evidence methods (worked examples, retrieval, interleaving, spacing) – they cover 9 of 10 gap types at ₹0; (4) spend money only on a written gap list, and re-test to see if it worked (#426 recommendation effectiveness). Rank 1 = do first; Effort = what it demands of the student; Money = Free / Low / Paid.
